licenseBasis: The Commons file descriptions state public domain in the source country and countries with life + 70 years or fewer, and in the United States due to early publication. Every downloaded card had Public domain metadata and PD-old-70-expired category.
attribution: Artwork: Pamela Colman Smith, Rider–Waite–Smith Tarot (1909). Original Roses & Lilies edition, scans by Saskia Jansen. Source: Wikimedia Commons. Public domain.
processing: Downloaded original JPEGs or standard 500px thumbnails linked by Commons imageinfo metadata. Original-download SHA-1 values verified against Commons; each downloaded image dimension checked against the corresponding metadata. All original Commons SHA-1 values and downloaded SHA-256 values are recorded. Proportional resize to 500 pixels wide where necessary; WebP quality 82, method 6. No cropping, recoloring, retouching, illustration replacement or generated artwork.
ordering: 00–21 major arcana, Strength 08 and Justice 11; 22–35 Wands; 36–49 Cups; 50–63 Swords; 64–77 Pentacles. Suits are Ace, 2–10, Page, Knight, Queen, King.
